sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: This podcast is for English beginner listeners for A1 to A2 listeners.
sentences.tc: 該播客適合 A1 至 A2 的英語初學者聽眾。

sentences.en: Today I will be talking about sleep and rest.
sentences.tc: 今天我要談談睡眠和休息。

sentences.en: Today I woke up late not early but late I woke up around 10 a.m.
sentences.tc: 今天我醒得很晚，不是很早，而是很晚，大約上午10點左右就醒了。

sentences.en: I was so sleepy I went to bed last night around 11 p.m.
sentences.tc: 昨晚我太睏了，晚上 11 點左右就上床睡覺了。

sentences.en: I woke up at 10 a.m. that means I had 11 hours of sleep last night.
sentences.tc: 我早上 10 點起床，這意味著我昨晚睡了 11 個小時。

sentences.en: I usually don't sleep that much but last night I was really really tired.
sentences.tc: 我通常睡得不多，但昨晚我真的很累。

sentences.en: I usually have a lot of energy and I don't need too much sleep but lately maybe the past 3 days.
sentences.tc: 我通常精力充沛，不需要太多睡眠，但最近可能是過去三天。

sentences.en: I have been feeling very tired and sleepy I haven't had so much energy lately.
sentences.tc: 我最近感覺很累，很困，沒有那麼多精力。

sentences.en: I take care of myself and I try to get as much rest as.
sentences.tc: 我照顧好自己，盡量多休息。

sentences.en: I can like one of my students said a good night sleep is only half the battle so as long as.
sentences.tc: 我可以像我的一位學生所說的那樣，只要睡個好覺就成功了一半。

sentences.en: I get a good night sleep I think everything else will be perfect and luckily.
sentences.tc: 我睡了個好覺，我想其他一切都會很完美，很幸運。

sentences.en: I could sleep in late this morning because I didn't have any early morning lessons to teach.
sentences.tc: 今天早上我可以睡得很晚，因為我沒有任何早課要教。

sentences.en: I could sleep in late because I didn't have work but otherwise.
sentences.tc: 我可以睡得很晚，因為我沒有工作，但除此之外。

sentences.en: I normally get up at 8 a.m. to teach every morning and it's so frustrating.
sentences.tc: 我通常每天早上八點起床去上課，這真是令人沮喪。

sentences.en: Sometimes to fall asleep.
sentences.tc: 有時為了睡覺。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's difficult for me to fall asleep at night I just lay in bed and I wait and I wait but I can't fall asleep.
sentences.tc: 有時晚上我很難入睡，我只是躺在床上等啊等，但就是睡不著。

sentences.en: Sometimes and it's especially from frustrating when I have an early class.
sentences.tc: 有時，尤其是當我上早課時，這尤其令人沮喪。

sentences.en: In the morning when I have to wake up early.
sentences.tc: 早上，當我必須早起的時候。

sentences.en: Then I don't get my full 8 hours of sleep and without my 8 hours of sleep.
sentences.tc: 然後我就無法獲得完整的 8 小時睡眠，也沒有 8 小時睡眠。

sentences.tc: 我無法正常工作，無法去健身房，無法上課，也無法與朋友一起出去玩。

sentences.en: I don't get my full 8 hours of sleep how many hours of sleep.
sentences.tc: 我不知道我的完整 8 小時睡眠是多少小時。

sentences.en: Do you need?
sentences.tc: 你需要嗎？

sentences.en: Do you get enough sleep I try to sleep early like 10 10 p.m. is early for me but on the weekends like Saturday and Sunday when I don't work?
sentences.tc: 你睡眠充足嗎？我盡量早點睡覺，例如晚上 10 點 10 點。對我來說還早，但是在周六和周日等週末我不工作的時候呢？
